in_sanskrit.name: Aryo
in_sanskrit.meaning: noble, virtuous, excellent, honorable, nobleman, or member of the Aryan race
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The term 'Aryo' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arya' which means 'noble', 'virtuous', 'excellent', 'honorable', 'nobleman', or 'member of the Aryan race'. It is a term of respect and admiration, indicating a person of high moral character and social standing.

in_marathi.name: Aryo
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryo हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arya’, meaning ‘noble’ or ‘honorable’. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘arya’ refers to the noble or respectable social class. The name Aryo is thus a reflection of noble character and high moral values.
